title.zh: OpenShell – A safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents
title.en: OpenShell – A safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents

current_state.zh: NVIDIA published OpenShell, an open-source runtime that confines fleets of autonomous AI agents while still letting them read files, install packages, call APIs, and use credentials, with opt-out anonymous telemetry and Helm-based deployment.
current_state.en: NVIDIA published OpenShell, an open-source runtime that confines fleets of autonomous AI agents while still letting them read files, install packages, call APIs, and use credentials, with opt-out anonymous telemetry and Helm-based deployment.
